name: Another Black Hole Incremental
summary: Another Black Hole Incremental is an incremental roguelike in which the player controls a black hole. Each run is limited by a constantly draining stability timer; feeding on dust, asteroids, moons, planets, and stars slows the drain. When the timer expires, the run's progress converts into Hawking Radiation, a permanent currency spent on an upgrade constellation that persists across runs. Play progresses through four scale tiers — asteroid, lunar, stellar, and galactic — ending in the consumption of a galactic core, followed by an endless mode with escalating depth. Systems offer seeded route choices, optional side missions, and a date-seeded daily challenge in which all players receive the same field and modifier. A free demo is available.
